rationale: Presentation axis excludes moisture and bulk consistency.
Powder is particle presentation; exact threshold remains unspecified.
Cake is coherent presentation, often but not universally produced by pressing.
Dried describes moisture condition, not shape.
Mixed describes presentation; composition remains separate.
Whole describes intact presentation; material integrity remains independently governed.
Pulp describes moist fibrous or cellular bulk consistency.
Slurry requires dispersed solids in a liquid continuous phase.
Comminuted particles do not entail dry solid bulk state.
Meal does not globally entail drying.
Separates bulk flow and dispersion semantics.
Fresh is condition rather than dehydration process.
